provenance.note: A fixed threshold. The simple shaver does not adapt to prices or forecasts.

provenance.label: Wattsmart reserve: 25% of Pulse energy
provenance.note: Energy held back in Pulse above its floor for utility dispatch. Labeled assumption.

provenance.label: Rush hour: each day's busiest 4-hour block of PACE demand
provenance.note: Same rule as the Plan screen. Falls back to 5-9 p.m. on days without PACE data.

provenance.label: DETOUR's load forecast: the same weekday's highest load in the last four weeks
provenance.note: For each 15-minute slot, the highest site load on the same weekday 7, 14, 21 and 28 days earlier. Planning on the high side keeps Pulse ready for a peak the forecast missed; a live cap covers the rest.

provenance.label: Perfect hindsight: one LP over the whole month with the real load
provenance.note: Knows every interval of the month in advance and minimizes only the bill. No real controller can match it; capture rate is measured against it.

provenance.label: EIA-930 hourly generation by fuel type, PACE balancing authority
EIA-930 hourly demand, PACE balancing authority
Coal emission factor, 2.26 lb CO2/kWh (assumption: national annual average)
provenance.note: EIA FAQ national average, not a Utah plant rate

provenance.label: Natural gas emission factor, 0.97 lb CO2/kWh (assumption: national annual average)
provenance.note: One factor for combined-cycle and combustion turbines

provenance.label: Torus Spin 10C
provenance.note: Secondary article quoting Torus. 10C means energy = power / 10 kWh (6 minutes at full power). Wattsmart-approved band is 30 kW-1.2 MW per system.

provenance.label: Torus Pulse 4-8 h duration
provenance.note: Published duration range 4-8 h; we size at 4 h. Wattsmart-approved band is 30 kW-1.2 MW per system.

provenance.label: Spin round-trip efficiency
provenance.note: Assumed 0.90 round trip.

provenance.label: Spin self-discharge per 15 min
provenance.note: Assumed 0.3% of stored energy lost per step; a flywheel loses energy continuously.

provenance.label: Spin cycle life
provenance.note: Assumption: vendor spec class

provenance.label: Spin degradation cost
provenance.note: Assumed Spin replacement $590/kWh of rated energy, divided by 25,000 cycles x 1.0 usable = $0.0236/kWh. About 1/3 of Pulse.

provenance.label: Pulse charge efficiency
provenance.note: Assumed 0.95 (about 90% round trip).

provenance.label: Pulse discharge efficiency
provenance.note: Assumed 0.95 (about 90% round trip).

provenance.label: Pulse minimum charge left
provenance.note: Assumed 10% floor: Pulse never drops below this much charge left.

provenance.label: Pulse maximum charge
provenance.note: Assumed 95% ceiling on charge.

provenance.label: Pulse ramp limit
provenance.note: Assumed 25% of rated power per 15-minute step: a smoothness limit so fast transients go to Spin (LFP cells can ramp faster, but smooth dispatch limits wear).

provenance.label: Pulse cycle life
provenance.note: Assumption: vendor spec class

provenance.label: Pulse degradation cost
provenance.note: Assumed Pulse replacement $450/kWh, divided by 7,500 cycles x 0.85 usable kWh = $0.0706/kWh.

provenance.label: Spin rated power
provenance.note: Unit size chosen for this simulated site; within the Wattsmart 30 kW-1.2 MW band per system.

provenance.label: Pulse rated power
provenance.note: Unit size chosen for this simulated site; within the Wattsmart 30 kW-1.2 MW band per system.
